Notes: Shuttle gate in Unicorn Outpost at the captured mothership zone-in (about 65.36, 101.15, 181.69). No named gate dynel was in the scrape; this is a talk-and-teleport terminal. Teleports to Alien Mothership PF 386 at the captured arrive point if the player has the infiltrate quest. The Mission key item packet was not captured; the quest is the key.

hello.Text: The Unicorn shuttle gate to the alien mothership.
